text.p: * Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu attended the third Black Sea Economic Cooperation (BSEC) conference in Moscow.
* The BSEC countries decided to boost ties by holding regular meetings at ministerial level.
* Romanian crews took possession at Otopeni airport of two C-130 Hercules transport planes donated by the U.S. government to Romania's air force.
* As an EU associate-member, Romania attends the European Union's conference in Brussels on the single internal market.
* Rights groups Pro Democratia and LADO were so far the only bodies to accredit observers for November 3 polls, representatives of the Central Electoral Bureau (BEC) said.
The BEC is considering a measure to ban opinion polls in the interval between November 1 at midnight and November 3 at midnight, the representatives said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
